ModMetaData.name: RimUtinni: The Reckoning
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description:
WEBWORK_EGG_RECKONING_QUEST_1. The assassination quest family split out of WEBWORK_EGG_BLACKMARKET_BUILD_1, per that item's own close report: "needs a new C# plant-watcher verb, several unresolved numbers, and live-game verify outside its offline scope." Design: design/Jawa/worldbuilding/biomes/webwork_egg_blackmarket_2026-09-24.md §2 (the quest family) and §3 (the hatch mechanism), S5 rulings 2/3/6/7.
Ships one QuestScriptDef family, "The Reckoning": a debtor's outpost with three solution paths — (1) pay the Cartel directly (a TradeRequest silver delivery, same machinery RUT_WildsteamEggBounty already uses), (2) defeat the outpost in the open (vanilla site.AllEnemiesDefeated), (3) plant an RM_OllathrixEgg inside the outpost undetected and let it hatch that night (the one genuinely new C# verb this family needed).
RULINGS IMPLEMENTED, verbatim from S5: 2. Hatch mechanism: STAGED QUEST EVENT. RM_OllathrixEgg carries no CompHatcher and never hatches anywhere outside this quest — RM_QuestPart_EggHatch spawns the one RM_Ollathrix PawnKindDef directly once planted and the map reaches its next night window (23:00-02:00, the design's own literal citation). No second egg def, no comp on the shared item. 3. What hatches: JUVENILE. The spawned spider is the SAME RM_Ollathrix kind at a fixed biological age within its own lifeStageAges' AnimalJuvenile band (0.2-0.4 x 14y lifeExpectancy = 2.8-5.6y; 4.0y picked, INVENTED midpoint, disclosed) — no new PawnKindDef, per §0 ruling 2's one-race-one-kind law. It is spawned via the same PawnGenerator.GeneratePawn + MentalStateDefOf.ManhunterPermanent pattern IncidentWorker_AggressiveAnimals and Scripts_ItemPodThreat.xml's own manhunter-pack reward threat already use — a real, losable hostile animal, not a scripted kill. 6. Total deniability CONFIRMED. An undiscovered egg-hatch kill (QuestNode_End on EggHatched) carries no goodwillChangeAmount at all — the target's faction never learns anything. Discovery before the hatch (EggFoundBeforeHatch) is the ONLY branch that costs goodwill, and only then. 7. Quest-only planting stands. RM_OllathrixEgg is never given a hatch mechanism outside this quest's own RM_QuestPart_EggHatch — a player cannot buy eggs and free-plant them as weapons. The free-form colony-weapon version is WEBWORK_EGG_WEAPON_VERSION_1, explicitly out of scope here.
MECHANISM GAPS DISCLOSED (checked live against the decompiled engine via RimSage — nothing here is guessed): the design's own §2a hand-waves path 2 as "vanilla shuttle/caravan-delivery machinery" and names a bedroom-specific marked cell for the plant — neither exists as a nameable vanilla mechanism. No vanilla QuestNode captures "deliver a captured pawn to a settlement," and no SitePartDef places a single trackable, capturable NAMED individual the way DownedRefugee/ ItemStash's own site parts do for THEIR pawns. So: the "target" is a flavor-only QuestNode_ GeneratePawn (Villager, faction=$siteFaction) used for grammar and for goodwillChangeFactionOf, never placed on the map; the outpost's whole garrison (SitePartDef Outpost, requiresFaction, minThreatPoints 300 — genuinely "standard machinery" per the design's own words) stands in for "his men," and path 2's success is the real vanilla site.AllEnemiesDefeated signal (an actual fight, a real win condition) rather than a scripted capture. The egg-plant check is "any RM_OllathrixEgg lying roofed and unfogged anywhere on the site map" rather than a single marked bedroom cell, since no vanilla API identifies which building is "the target's bedroom" inside a procedurally generated Outpost. Both are disclosed simplifications, not silent inventions.
INVENTED NUMBERS (same disclosure posture as RUT_WildsteamEggBounty's own header — picked within or near the design's own ❓ ranges, not silently guessed, all in RUT_Reckoning.xml's own header comment): - expireDaysRange (offer window) 4~8, matching this campaign's own quest family convention. - Completion timer 10-15 days (design's own ❓ range, used as given). - Path 1 payoff: ~2x the base reward (design's own "roughly 2x"). - Path 2 goodwill penalty -8 (open, visible abduction — legal-adjacent per §2a). - Path 3 post-plant discovery goodwill penalty -25 (the design doc's own ❓-25, carried forward as given rather than re-invented). - Post-plant per-hour discovery chance 3%. - Juvenile hatch fixed biological age 4.0 years. - minRefireDays 30 and rootSelectionWeight 0.15 on the natural-pool fallback route. - rootMinPoints 300, matching Outpost's own minThreatPoints exactly (not arbitrary).
FIRING ROUTES (skill §7): RUT_Reckoning_CartelOffer is the primary route (givenBy Traders, randomlySelectable false — vanilla's givenBy tag is generic to ALL traders, not filterable to one TraderKindDef, so "the Cartel hands you the contract" is fiction over a generic-trader-offer mechanism, disclosed). RUT_Reckoning_Rumor is the low-weight natural-pool fallback for colonies that never meet a trader, ParentName-inheriting the same root tree (skill §3: ParentName inherits the whole tree and text packs).
OFFLINE-ONLY VERIFY: validate_quest.py clean, dotnet build clean against the real installed Assembly-CSharp.dll. NOT verified: whether GenHostility.AnyHostileActiveThreatToPlayer's "undetected" reading matches what a human would call stealthy, whether the Outpost SitePartDef reliably generates a roofed indoor cell the egg can be dropped in, and whether the juvenile spawn is tuned right in a real fight — all three need a live dev-mode "Generate quest" pass, which is bridge/game-up work this item's own scope note excludes (needs: offline).
Depends on mandrake.rm.webwork (RM_OllathrixEgg, RM_Ollathrix) and mandrake.rut.patches (RUT_Jawa_HuttCartel, the FactionDef the settlement-finder node is scoped to).
